about: Shell commands for the gate. {brief} is a file whose text serves P1, {nobrief} one that serves nothing, {tmp} their directory (the Claude cwd and the Codex workdir). want: 0 allow, 2 deny. The first eight are data that only MENTIONS a dispatch; the pre-tokenizer gate denied them.

cases.label: printf from the 2026-09-25 false positive
cases.command: printf '%s\n' "- 15:40Z fleet value 720 h verified; a REAL undeclared bb thread tell from this session was DENIED, with P1-P3 listed" >> {tmp}/plan.md

cases.label: grep for tells in a journal
git commit message naming a spawn
cases.command: git commit -m "gate denies bb thread spawn without serves"

cases.label: rg pattern with the dispatch words
heredoc into a notes file that contains a dispatch line
cases.command:
cat <<'EOF' > {tmp}/notes.md
bb thread tell thr_x don't forget
EOF

cases.label: jq piped to grep for thread tell
comment that mentions a dispatch
cases.command: ls # then bb thread tell thr_x hi

cases.label: separator inside single quotes is data
cases.command: echo 'done; bb thread tell thr_x hi' >> {tmp}/plan.md

cases.label: $(...) inside single quotes is not run
bb thread list is not a dispatch
cd d && bb thread spawn without serves
env FOO=1 bb thread tell
cases.command: env FOO=1 bb thread tell thr_x hi

cases.label: command bb thread message
cases.command: command bb thread message thr_x hi

cases.label: exec bb thread tell
cases.command: exec bb thread tell thr_x hi

cases.label: xargs -I{} bb thread tell
cases.command: printf 'thr_a\n' | xargs -I{} bb thread tell {} hi

cases.label: nice -n 5 bb thread tell
cases.command: nice -n 5 bb thread tell thr_x hi

cases.label: sudo -u me bb thread spawn
cases.command: sudo -u me bb thread spawn --prompt x

cases.label: stdbuf -oL bb thread tell
cases.command: stdbuf -oL bb thread tell thr_x hi

cases.label: find -exec bb thread tell
cases.command: find . -name x -exec bb thread tell thr_x hi \;

cases.label: timeout 30 bb thread list is not a dispatch
timeout 30 bb thread tell with serves
cases.command: timeout 30 bb thread tell thr_x 'serves: P1 hi'

cases.label: true || bb thread tell
cases.command: true || bb thread tell thr_x hi

cases.label: echo ok; bb thread tell on a new line
cases.command:
echo ok
bb thread tell thr_x hi

cases.label: serves in a sibling echo does not cover the tell
cases.command: echo "serves: P1"; bb thread tell thr_x hi

cases.label: heredoc brief without serves
cases.command:
bb thread spawn --prompt-file - <<'EOF'
do the thing, don't ask
EOF

cases.label: bash reading a heredoc script that tells
cases.command:
bash <<'EOF'
bb thread tell thr_x hi
EOF

cases.label: two tells, only the first serves
cases.command: bb thread tell thr_a 'serves: P1 a' && bb thread tell thr_b 'b'

cases.label: heredoc brief with serves
cases.command:
bb thread spawn --prompt-file - <<'EOF'
serves: P1
don't stop
EOF

cases.label: $(cat <<EOF) brief with serves and an apostrophe
cases.command:
bb thread spawn --prompt "$(cat <<'EOF'
serves: P1
it's (still) open
EOF
)"

cases.label: cd d && bb thread spawn --prompt-file brief with serves
sh -c tell with serves
cases.command: sh -c 'bb thread tell thr_x "serves: P1 hi"'

cases.label: two tells, both serve
cases.command: bb thread tell thr_a 'serves: P1 a' && bb thread tell thr_b 'serves: P1 b' 2>&1
